findings.evidence: Compare Sheaf/Stalk.lean:76-86 with TensorProduct/Stalk.lean:139-149 (identical modulo `sheafificationUnit S P` ↦ `f.val`), and Sheaf/Stalk.lean:93-99 with TensorProduct/Stalk.lean:157-163. `stalkLiftCommRing` requires only `S : X.Presheaf CommRingCat` (Presheaf/Stalk.lean:73).
findings.fix: Add one public general `PresheafOfModules.stalkMap (f : P ⟶ Q) (x)` plus `stalkMap_germ` for `P Q : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing S` with `S : X.Presheaf CommRingCat` (where `stalkLiftCommRing` already lives, Presheaf/Stalk.lean:80), then define `sheafificationStalkMap := stalkMap (sheafificationUnit S P)` and use `PresheafOfModules.stalkMap f.val x` here; delete both private copies.
findings.issue: `private def stalkMap {P Q : SheafOfModules (ringCatSheaf R)} (f : P ⟶ Q)` duplicates the existing `private def PresheafOfModules.sheafificationStalkMap` (Sheaf/Stalk.lean:71), with the same `stalkLiftCommRing (germ ∘ f.app)` body and verbatim-identical `res`/`smul` proof arguments; `stalkMap_germ` (line 152) likewise duplicates `sheafificationStalkMap_germ` (Sheaf/Stalk.lean:88). The sheaf hypotheses on `P`, `Q` are unused — the body only mentions `P.val`, `Q.val`, `f.val`.

findings.evidence: `def tensorProductIso (M N) : tensorProduct R M N ≅ (sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)).obj (M.val ⊗ N.val) := Iso.refl _` — TensorProduct/Basic.lean:107-110; grep shows `stalkMap` used only at TensorProduct/Stalk.lean:174, 215, 221, always on `(tensorProductIso R M N).hom`.
findings.fix: Drop the `stalkMap` factor from `tensorStalkComparison` (use the definitional identification `tensorProduct_val` / `tensorProductIso = Iso.refl`) and state the germ lemma for `germ (tensorProduct R M N).val.presheaf U x hx (((sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 _)).unit.app (M.val ⊗ N.val)).app (op U) (m ⊗ₜ n))` without the `(tensorProductIso R M N).inv.val.app` wrapper.
findings.issue: The only instantiation of the new `stalkMap` is `stalkMap R x (tensorProductIso R M N).hom`, and `tensorProductIso` is `Iso.refl _`, so this factor is the identity; the abstraction buys nothing here, and the identity also appears in the public statement `tensorStalkComparison_germ_unit_tmul` as `(tensorProductIso R M N).inv.val.app (op U) …`, so the simp lemma only fires on terms carrying that redundant wrapper rather than on a germ of a sheafified pure tensor as a user would produce it.

summary: The new private `SheafOfModules.stalkMap` re-proves the existing private `PresheafOfModules.sheafificationStalkMap` at a strictly narrower level (sheafiness of P, Q never used), so the repo gains a second copy instead of one general stalk map of a morphism of presheaves of modules. Its sole instantiation is at `tensorProductIso`, which is `Iso.refl`, and that identity leaks into the public germ simp lemma.
